title: The query-log pool rows no arm passed check the article that answers them
goal: Each of the three query-log pool rows no arm passed on 2026-10-08 (BP-36864ffb, BP-9b5aab96, BP-ab7a8cc2) is read against the kb: a row whose check names the wrong article gets the article that answers it (through pool build --querylog's choice of article, not a hand edit), and a row the kb does not answer leaves the pool or becomes a gap-kind row, with the reason in the item's notes; benchmarks.py pool check --querylog exits 0

run: import csv,sys; old={'BP-36864ffb':'scopes','BP-9b5aab96':'foundry','BP-ab7a8cc2':'mcp'}; rows={r['id']:r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_querylog/bench/pool.csv',encoding='utf-8'))}; bad=[i for i,c in old.items() if i in rows and c in rows[i]['checks']]; sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

gates.question: How does the query-log pool build pick the article a row's check names?
options: The article the stored pack named, kept while the kb's pack for the question still prints it, else the best article that pack prints now
Always the best article the kb's pack for the question prints now
Always the article the stored pack named
gates.recommendation: The article the stored pack named, kept while the kb's pack for the question still prints it, else the best article that pack prints now
gates.answer: The article the stored pack named, kept while the kb's pack for the question still prints it, else the best article that pack prints now

gates.question: What becomes of a query-log pool row whose question the public kb does not answer because the store's cited answer lies in the project's own docs?
options: It leaves the pool, and the build draws another row in its place
It stays as a gap-kind row
gates.recommendation: It leaves the pool, and the build draws another row in its place
gates.answer: It leaves the pool, and the build draws another row in its place

gates.question: Does the query-log pool build keep the rows of the committed file, as the public build does, when it redraws a row?
options: It keeps each committed row whose store entry is still usable and draws only the rows it lacks
It redraws all rows from the seed on every build
gates.recommendation: It keeps each committed row whose store entry is still usable and draws only the rows it lacks
gates.answer: It keeps each committed row whose store entry is still usable and draws only the rows it lacks

gates.question: How many articles of the kb's pack does the querylog build read when it checks that a row's stored article is still printed?
options: eight, so a row the item did not name (BP-203233ce) keeps its check
the pack's default four, which also moves BP-203233ce's check
gates.recommendation: eight, so a row the item did not name (BP-203233ce) keeps its check
gates.answer: eight, so a row the item did not name (BP-203233ce) keeps its check
